system.description: Severing a sliver of your own nose or earlobe, crushing it to paste, and dusting your face with the result costs one unsoakable level of bashing damage, but lets you immediately and infallibly know whether the very next ritual you cast has succeeded or failed, even if that ritual has no visible effect of its own.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
